confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the heating element has most likely failed. On Beko vented dryers like your DV7110, this is the standard part that goes'

unjustifiedPart.evidence: Heading 'Likely cause: heater element' and directing the customer to buy and replace the element without any continuity test

rationale: The assistant jumped to the heating element as the most likely fault, even though the clogged vent hose pointed to a tripped one-shot thermal cut-out and nothing had been tested. It never mentioned the thermal cut-out as an alternative after the airflow fix, never suggested testing or an engineer for a customer with no multimeter, and ignored the clogged-hose detail the customer flagged. It did correctly decline to give a part number and told the customer to unplug before work, but the advice to read the model from the rating plate 'inside the door rim' is unsupported, and it offered DIY element replacement without any testing.
